Agent capabilities
Image reading
Image reading
Automatically extract embedded images when reading Markdown files, sending them to the model as multimodal content.
Fetch external image URLs
Also fetch http(s) image URLs referenced in Markdown (image hosts, CDNs). Disabled by default — enabling it will send outbound requests to third-party hosts. Fetches time out after 5s and skip images larger than 10MB.
Image compression
Compress extracted images to reduce token usage and transfer size.
Compression quality
Image compression ratio (1-100). Controls both dimensions and quality, e.g. 60 scales to 60% size at 60% quality.
Context compaction
Automatic context compaction
Before a request that would reach the threshold, automatically compact earlier conversation. The Agent can still call the compaction tool on its own at any time.
Context window usage (%)
Compact when the next request is estimated to fill this share of the model's context window. The window comes from the model's max context setting, or 200k when unset. To compact earlier, lower the percentage or the model's max context.
External agent access
Allow external agent access
Allow external agents to search the Vault through MCP and delegate tasks to configured YOLO agents.
CLI runtimes
Claude Code CLI path
Custom path to the claude executable — paste the output of "which claude" ("where claude" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
Codex CLI path
Custom path to the codex executable — paste the output of "which codex" ("where codex" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
Hermes CLI path
Custom path to the hermes executable — paste the output of "which hermes" ("where hermes" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
Pi CLI path
Custom path to the pi executable — paste the output of "which pi" ("where pi" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
omp CLI path
Custom path to the omp executable — paste the output of "which omp" ("where omp" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
Grok CLI path
Custom path to the grok executable — paste the output of "which grok" ("where grok" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
CodeBuddy CLI path
Custom path to the codebuddy executable — paste the output of "which codebuddy" ("where codebuddy" on Windows). Leave empty to auto-detect. Stored on this device only.
